verdict.rationale: New Relic's Service Level Management explicitly supports defining and consuming SLIs/SLOs, and NRQL-based alerts (its 'primary and most powerful' alert type) can be layered to implement burn-rate style alerting on top of SLO data. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of a native 'error budget burn-rate alert' template/wizard (as some competitors have) and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow beyond docs.
